newsitem.title: USA: US FCC wireless chief to resign post in April.
newsitem.headline: US FCC wireless chief to resign post in April.

text.p: The head of the Federal Communications Commission's wireless bureau, Michele Farquhar, is stepping down next month from her post, FCC Chairman Reed Hundt said Tuesday.
Hundt suggested that she would return to the private sector, but gave no details.

"At my request, Michele continued in this job long after she promised her family she would return to the private sector," Hundt said in a speech in San Francisco to the Cellular Telecommunications Industry Association.
In the speech, which was released in Washington, Hundt said Farquhar would leave the job in April.
